title: EPC-3D-Diff: Equivariant Physics Consistent Conditional 3D Latent Diffusion for CBCT to CT Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2605.20470v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cone-beam CT (CBCT) is routinely acquired during radiotherapy for patient setup, but its quantitative reliability is degraded by scatter, noise, and reconstruction artifacts, limiting Hounsfield Unit (HU) accuracy. We propose EPC-3D-Diff, a novel conditional 3D latent diffusion framework for volumetric CBCT to CT synthesis that introduces a projection domain equivariance loss derived from acquisition physics. Unlike common image domain equivariance, we exploit the fact that an in plane rotation of the volume corresponds to an angular shift in its projections. During training, we enforce this relationship by forward projecting rotated synthesized CT volumes and matching them to appropriately angle shifted projections of the paired target CT, yielding a physics consistent equivariance constraint integrated into the diffusion objective. translated_title: EPC-3D-Diff：用于CBCT到CT合成的等变物理一致性条件3D潜在扩散模型
translated_abstract: 锥形束CT（CBCT）通常在放射治疗过程中获取用于患者摆位，但其定量可靠性因散射、噪声和重建伪影而降低，限制了霍恩斯菲尔德单位（HU）的准确性。我们提出了EPC-3D-Diff，一种新颖的条件3D潜在扩散框架，用于体积CBCT到CT的合成，该框架引入了从采集物理推导出的投影域等变损失。与常见的图像域等变性不同，我们利用了体积的平面内旋转对应于其投影中角度偏移这一事实。在训练过程中，我们通过对旋转后的合成CT体积进行前向投影，并将其与配对目标CT的相应角度偏移投影进行匹配来强制执行这种关系，从而产生整合到扩散目标中的物理一致性等变约束。为了高效地捕获完整的3D上下文，条件扩散在紧凑的潜在空间中执行。
tldr: 本文提出EPC-3D-Diff框架，通过基于采集物理推导的投影域等变损失约束条件3D潜在扩散模型，实现从CBCT到CT的高质量体积合成，显著提升HU值准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EPC-3D-Diff, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework for volumetric CBCT-to-CT synthesis that enforces a physics-derived projection domain equivariance loss to improve HU accuracy.
